design: Secondary prospective assessment of one frozen CPU-encoded policy after all three previous GPU candidates failed development. The formal prediction directories for this policy were absent. Partial external development scores are not used for selection or stopping.
endpoints: Apply the original full-cohort gain criterion and report each contrast. Assess selective placement against always, training-rate-matched and per-history-count-matched controls. Report external answerable-question micro F1, paired stratified intervals and separate abstention scores.
stopping: Finish all six arms on both locked cohorts irrespective of interim scores. Keep the fitted weights fixed. Report a null or adverse result.
